title: Garden Day
style: Indie-pop with a breezy mid-tempo swing, brushed drums and acoustic guitar driving the verse; pre-chorus lifts with handclaps, bass climb, and a filtered synth bloom; chorus opens wide with stacked harmonies, tambourine, and a chantable hook. Lead vocal stays close-mic and warm, with doubled lines on the hook, short delay throws, and a few background oohs. Vinyl crackle, pedal-steel swells, and a soft riser into each chorus. Bright, clean, sunlit mix with gentle low-end bounce.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Dirt on your knees
Green on your hands
Tomatoes leaning
Like they understand

The hose makes rain
On your old blue shoes
You laugh so easy
I forget my blues

[Pre-Chorus]
Sun on the fence
Breeze in the row
You say my name
Like you already know

[Chorus]
Garden day, garden day
Stay right here
Garden day, garden day
Pull me near
Sweet pea vines
And your smile
Garden day, garden day
Stay a while

[Verse 2]
You cut the beans
I hold the basket
Straw hat tilted
That worn-out classic

The earth smells warm
After morning rain
Your elbows dirty
And you call it gain

[Pre-Chorus]
The sky stays high
The clouds move slow
You say my name
And the whole yard glows

[Chorus]
Garden day, garden day
Stay right here
Garden day, garden day
Pull me near
Sweet pea vines
And your smile
Garden day, garden day
Stay a while

[Bridge]
We don't need much
Just shade and seed
Your hand in mine
And a row to weed

[Final Chorus]
Garden day, garden day
Stay right here
Garden day, garden day
Pull me near
Sweet pea vines
And your smile
Garden day, garden day
Stay a while
